answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available. KL 0.095 and TV 0.089 are in the fine-tuned range (0.081-0.205 and 0.076-0.099). They are too large for quantized (KL 0.039-0.071, TV 0.048-0.055) and too small for system-prompted (KL 0.197-0.339, TV 0.108-0.144). Top-1 agreement of 0.910 and sequence agreement of 0.469 fit fine-tuned (0.900-0.938 and 0.47-0.64), and also fit system-prompted at its edge (0.861-0.908 and 0.31-0.48). The raw-score shift ÷ TV of 9.2 is well above the quantized (2.2-2.3) and system-prompted (3.3-3.9) ranges and sits in the fine-tuned range (3.1-10.8), which is the strongest evidence. The Token-DiFR gap of 0.469 is high for fine-tuned (0.10-0.31) and matches system-prompted (0.28-0.52), so system-prompted is not fully excluded. Base is ruled out because every difference is non-zero.
